scripts.prep:html: mkdir -p dist && ln -sfn ../img dist/img && ln -sfn ../resources dist/resources
scripts.dev: npm run prep:html && marp --watch --html --allow-local-files presentation.md --theme-set theme --output dist/index.html
scripts.build: npm run prep:html && marp presentation.md --html --allow-local-files --theme-set theme --output dist/index.html
